steps.title: Diagnose Loader Freeze and Page Block Root Cause
steps.description: Identify that the startup loader was reliant on deferred network events and an end-of-script initialization, leaving the overlay stuck if any resource delayed.

steps.title: Add Guaranteed Immediate Inline Dismissal Guard
steps.description: Embed a lightweight inline safety controller directly inside index.html ensuring the loader dismisses immediately within milliseconds under all conditions.

steps.title: Prioritize Preloader Initialization in Script
steps.description: Move loader activation and dismissal to the immediate top of script.js with comprehensive try-catch wrappers so DOM execution never halts.

steps.title: Reinforce Non-Blocking CSS Visibility Classes
steps.description: Ensure style.css enforces pointer-events: none and visibility: hidden when the loader is dismissed so calculator controls are instantly accessible.

steps.title: Safeguard Web Audio API and LocalStorage Access
steps.description: Wrap localStorage theme reads and AudioContext creation in safe fallback blocks to prevent cross-origin iframe security exceptions from stalling execution.

steps.title: Provide User Tap Fallback on Loader
steps.description: Enable instant tap-to-dismiss on the preloader overlay as a manual failsafe for zero-latency user interaction.

steps.title: Harden Unit Conversion and Scientific Drawer State
steps.description: Verify proper initialization of conversion dropdowns and drawer elements without throwing runtime errors on fresh startup.

steps.title: Optimize Responsive Calc Layout Rendering
steps.description: Ensure the main calculator container renders smoothly with zero layout shift once the preloader fades away.

steps.title: Test Theme Toggle and Offline Math Logic
steps.description: Verify light/dark toggle and all arithmetic/scientific operations function deterministically offline.

steps.title: Building moderncalc
steps.description: Complete final verification ensuring the loader cleanly vanishes immediately and the calculator page is instantly visible and interactive.
